banner.title: Your cookie choices
banner.description: We use cookies that the site needs to work. With your permission we also use cookies for visit statistics, for crediting the member who invited you, and to load videos and music from other sites. Nothing optional is used until you choose.
banner.preferencesIntro: Pick the optional cookies you allow. You can change this at any time from the footer.
banner.revisionMessage: The cookie policy has changed since your last choice, so we are asking again.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Keep you signed in and remember your language, theme, Data saver settings and these choices. The site does not work without them, so they cannot be switched off.

analytics.title: Statistics
analytics.description: Count visits and pages so the site's team can see how it is used. Only if the site has statistics turned on.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Remember which member invited you, so they are credited if you register.

embeds.title: Embedded content
embeds.description: Load videos and music hosted on other sites (YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify and others) inside posts. Those sites may set their own cookies.

policy.title: Cookie policy
policy.intro: This page lists everything this site stores in your browser, why, and for how long. Cookies and similar storage (local storage and session storage) are covered alike. The strictly necessary ones are listed for information and do not need your consent; every other category stays off until you accept it.
policy.yourChoice: To see or change what you allowed, use “Cookie settings” in the page footer, or the button below. Withdrawing a category deletes its cookies.
policy.optionalNote: Needs your consent. Off until you accept it.
policy.name: Name
policy.noNames: Set by the provider, not by this site

session.title: Sign-in
session.purpose: Keeps you signed in and keeps a short copy of your session so pages load quickly. Set only when you sign in.
session.lifetime: Until you sign out. If you tick “remember me”, up to the length of a session set by the site (30 days by default); otherwise until you close the browser.

consent.title: Your cookie choices
consent.purpose: Records the categories you accepted, the policy version and the date, so you are not asked on every page and can be asked again when the policy changes.

dataSaver.title: Data saver
dataSaver.purpose: Remembers which pictures you chose not to load.

dataSaverReloads.title: Data saver tabs
dataSaverReloads.purpose: Stops a page from reloading again and again when you change Data saver in another tab.

notices.title: Closed notices
notices.purpose: Remembers which site notices a visitor without an account has closed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.purpose: Remembers whether you chose the light, dark or system theme.
theme.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

width.title: Page width
width.purpose: Remembers whether you chose the narrow page width.
width.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

panels.title: Collapsed panels
panels.purpose: Remembers which forum categories and panels you folded.
panels.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

matomo.title: Statistics (Matomo)
matomo.purpose: Tells visits and pages apart so the site's team can see how it is used. The data goes to the site's own Matomo server.
matomo.lifetime: From 30 minutes to 13 months, depending on the cookie.

google.title: Statistics (Google Analytics)
google.purpose: Tells visits and pages apart so the site's team can see how it is used. The data goes to Google.
google.lifetime: From 1 minute to 2 years, depending on the cookie.

referral.title: Referrals
referral.purpose: Remembers which member's invitation link brought you here, so they are credited if you register.

embeds.title: Embedded content
embeds.purpose: A video or music player from another site is loaded only after you press “Load” or accept this category. Once loaded, that site may set its own cookies; this site cannot see or delete them. See each provider's own policy.
